gaps.quote: Values therefore do not grow, and fixed-point arithmetic needs no extra bits.
gaps.note: Stronger than what the bound supports. The bound only shows normalized values stay within the disk. The paper (sources/paper.tex lines 3405-3409, 3481-3486) returns the product at component width w_M = w + log_2 M, i.e. extra bits, and rounding to the p-bit grid is still needed (error bound sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, line 3397). The paper's own text at lines 3385-3389 states only the contraction bound and the disk-array error rule, not a no-extra-bits claim.
